instruction.text: Fill in the correct verbs, using the present progressive.
instruction.sound: Fill in the correct verbs, using the present progressive.

atoms.b: The city council ((is_meeting)) tomorrow to discuss the new public transport routes. Representatives of the transport service ((are_presenting)) their revised traffic plans. Afterwards, the council ((is_holding)) a press briefing. Later in the afternoon, the mayor ((is_visiting)) the central station while the engineers ((are_working)) on the new transport lines.

A team of marine scientist ((is_launching)) a research expedition this week. They ((are_planning)) to study rising water temperatures. For this, they ((are_deploying)) new sensors in order to collect more precise data. Later next week, the team ((is_analysing)) their findings at a laboratory. At the end of the month they ((are_publishing)) a first report.

hint.text: to deploy sth. – to position or to install sth.
hint.sound: To deploy something means to position or to install something.
hint.label: hint

atoms.b: Local representatives ((are_drafting)) a proposal in the coming months to address rising housing costs. The city ((is_consulting)) neighbourhood groups on Wednesday for community input. On Friday, the mayoral office ((is_organising)) a public forum in the town hall. Throughout the month, council members ((are_inspecting)) several housing units. At the end of the month, they ((are_submitting)) their reports.

hint.text:
to draft sth. – to create a first version of sth., to write sth. or design sth.
to submit sth. – to give or offer sth.
hint.sound: To draft something means to create a first version of something, to write something or to design something. To submit something means to give or offer something.
hint.label: hint
